llm_justification.summary: A sharp move in the probability of Netanyahu leaving office by end-2026 would flag an Israeli political regime shift, most cleanly proxied by the Israel equity ETF (EIS) and the shekel. However, the direction is genuinely ambiguous — an exit could be market-positive (reduced institutional/geopolitical friction) or negative (governance chaos, election risk) — and the long resolution horizon plus global-beta contamination make a large, directional 12h move unlikely. Both mappings are low-confidence and below the tradable threshold.
